description: Focus on your strengths, develop / nourish your greatness #LifeByDesign #individualism #luxurylife
transcript: I only focus on the things that I'm good at. Everything else is what it is. It's so important for me to utilize my skills and understand that I have things that others don't and others have skills that I don't. And it is my job to refine those skills. It is my job to look at all the things that are great about me and nourish those. I don't always need to be learning something new. Sometimes those things that are new, that do come our way, are built in order to allow us to see a different version of the ideas and the thoughts that we have in order to help us refine them. I am only focused on the things that I do great.
